context.problem_statement: Build a logistic regression churn prediction model and analyze feature importance via coefficients. The dataset contains customer features and a binary churn label (1=churned). Steps: (1) encode categorical variables (gender: M/F), (2) standardize numerical features, (3) fit logistic regression with L2 regularization (C=1.0), (4) report standardized coefficients (feature importances) sorted by absolute value, (5) compute model accuracy, AUC-ROC, and report the top 3 most predictive features, (6) interpret the direction of each coefficient (positive = increases churn probability).
context.expert_knowledge: Logistic regression coefficients after standardization are directly comparable feature importances. Positive coefficient = feature increases churn odds. Odds ratio = exp(coefficient). Use sklearn LogisticRegression with solver='lbfgs'. Standardization essential for coefficient comparison. Coefficient p-values can be approximated using statsmodels LogisticRegression.
